standouts.head: Holding its rising 50-day
standouts.text: It dipped to its rising 50-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
standouts.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

standouts.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying
standouts.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 1 kind of strategy.
standouts.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

against.head: Recovered 28% of its one-year fall
against.text: The fall ran Jan 15 to May 13; price is inside the 23.6–38.2% band.
against.learn: Pullbacks often stop near 38%, 50% or 62% of the move before; past 62% the move itself is in doubt.

material.head: Retesting its breakout level
material.text: It broke out above the October high and has come back to test it from above: old resistance acting as new support.
material.learn: After a breakout, price often comes back to the line it broke; old resistance becomes new support.

material.head: Downtrend broken: over its last swing high
material.text: The swings had been falling, but price has closed over the last swing high (Oct 22): the run of lower highs is broken.
material.learn: A downtrend's first crack: a close over its latest lower high.

material.head: Weekly: wave 2 turning up from its zone
material.text: Five clean waves up from Oct 22, 2024 to Jan 15 (+214%, wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−8.6% to −27%), with the Oct 9, 2023 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−50%); a close over the wave-1 high (+58%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.

material.head: Next support −8.7% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −8.7% below (1.7 ATR), where 9 levels (4 kinds) meet: the 50-day average, the most-traded price of six months and the average price paid since the Oct 28 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Sitting on support
material.text: Price sits on the May breakout level, the October breakout level and the Jul 23 low.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: The trigger failed before
against.text: It closed above the trigger line once since Oct 14 and gave it back.
against.learn: A line price closed above and then gave back has failed once already; the next break has to hold to count.

against.head: Resistance +1.7% above
against.text: The nearest ceiling is +1.7% above (0.4 ATR), where 10 levels (4 kinds) meet: the Oct 1 low, the average price paid since the Oct 16 high and the 200-day average: little room before sellers have stepped in before.
against.learn: A ceiling: sellers stepped in there before.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 in its buy zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Aug 4, 2025 to May 7 (+166%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback has reached the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+1.7% to −6.8%), in three waves, on lighter volume, with the 50-week average and the Aug 10 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−32%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: Support −1.2% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −1.2% below (0.3 ATR), where 4 levels (2 kinds) meet: the Jun 10 low, the 50-week average and the Oct 23 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: In a 10-week base
material.text: It has moved sideways for 10 weeks in a range 24% deep after a +27% advance.
material.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.

material.head: Quiet selling on the dip
material.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 22% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.
material.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.
